purpose: Make the already-implemented Artist Focus jobs first-class progressive Home entry choices so an artist can begin Make, Finish, Manage, Release or Perform work before configuring a DAW, AI provider, account or service.

lineage.outcome: From the normal Headquarters Home path, the artist can choose the job they are here to do and enter the existing Focus contract without being diverted into setup. Song-scoped jobs follow the active Song when one exists; Artist-wide jobs remain Artist-wide.

why_now: Canonical REQ-SCOPE-096 says fresh Artist creation/selection and start/resume Song are already proven, while Finish/Release/Manage-specific progressive entry remains unproven. The five Focus modes and their durable Song/Artist binding already exist, so the missing customer behavior can be closed by integration rather than another onboarding or state subsystem. Current open audio, DAW, Song compare, transport, career, territory, credits and professional-evidence worklines own separate product surfaces.

implementation_contract.reuse: Use the existing AttentionMemory Focus modes, existing focus-set one-shot action, existing CSRF/Origin/Host protections and current Song binding rules.
implementation_contract.entry: Home presents Make, Finish, Manage, Release and Perform as direct artist-job choices with short outcome-oriented descriptions.
implementation_contract.binding: Make and Finish bind to the active Song when one exists under the existing Focus contract. Manage, Release and Perform remain Artist-wide unless a later exact context exists.
implementation_contract.setup: No DAW, provider, plugin, account, entitlement or network setup is required or implied merely to choose a job.
implementation_contract.persistence: No new persistence is introduced. The selected Focus continues to use canonical AttentionMemory and existing relaunch semantics.
implementation_contract.authority: Job selection changes only Focus state. It grants no DAW/provider/spend/publication/release authority.
implementation_contract.integration: The shell extension is implemented and tested independently. The minimal package installer hook must be added only when the currently claimed shared __init__.py seam is free or after reconstruction onto the then-current main.

completion_proof: fresh running Artist with no Song sees direct job-entry choices on Home without a setup prerequisite
Manage, Release and Perform can begin Artist-wide from Home with the existing one-shot focus-set authority
an active Song Home path exposes Finish and Make without losing Song context
choosing Finish with an active Song binds the canonical Focus to that exact Song
choosing an Artist-wide job does not create or mutate a Song
Home copy explicitly keeps DAW, AI and service setup contextual rather than prerequisite
foreign-Origin, bad-CSRF and replay protections remain governed by the existing focus-set action path
normal package composition installs the Home extension exactly once
full regression and staged consumer smoke pass at exact head
non_scope: new Focus modes or Attention persistence
new onboarding database or wizard state
